featured_reviews.name: Kavi Kris
featured_reviews.review_text:
I do training sessions with Vinutha each time I visit Mumbai, and she has been absolutely wonderful. Before training with her, I honestly had no clue about posture, proper form, or the correct way to use my body while lifting. She has been incredibly patient, knowledgeable, and supportive in teaching me the right techniques safely and correctly.

What I really appreciate is that her guidance does not stop after the in-person sessions — she is always happy to guide me online whenever I need help or have questions. Her passion for powerlifting and genuine care for her clients really shows. I already feel much more confident, aware, and comfortable with lifting because of her coaching. Highly recommend her to anyone wanting to improve their strength, technique, and confidence.

featured_reviews.name: Shantanu Kurup
featured_reviews.review_text:
Training under Vinutha Ma’am has genuinely changed the way I look at strength training and powerlifting. She brings a level of knowledge and practical understanding that is hard to find. What I appreciate the most is how closely she observes and corrects form, explains the “why” behind movements, and constantly pushes you to improve while still being extremely empathetic and approachable.

The coaching here does not feel robotic or generic. Every correction, cue, and training suggestion feels personalised to your strengths and limitations. Whether it’s technique, discipline, confidence under the bar, or mindset, you can feel the passion she has for coaching and for helping people genuinely progress safely and sustainably.

The environment is motivating, supportive, and serious about strength training without being intimidating. Highly recommend this place to anyone who wants to learn powerlifting properly or simply train under someone who truly knows the sport inside out.

featured_reviews.name: Priya B
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve had the privilege of training under an exceptional Coach Vinutha Raghunath and I can honestly say her guidance has been transformative. She strikes a rare balance ,deeply kind and empathetic, yet firm and disciplined when it matters most. That combination makes you feel both supported and challenged in the best way.

Her one on one coaching is truly individualised. She pays close attention to your body, your limitations, and your goals, and designs training that feels safe, sustainable, and effective. What stands out most is her depth of knowledge and experience, especially in weightlifting. You always feel like you’re in capable hands.

As a woman, and especially seeing how she works with older women, there’s a strong sense of trust and safety in her approach. She understands how to build strength without compromising the body, and that confidence she gives you is invaluable.

She is, without a doubt, one of the best coaches in India , not just for her technical expertise, but for the way she truly cares about her clients’ progress and well-being.

featured_reviews.name: Sagar
featured_reviews.review_text:
★★★★★

Joining Grippers Fitness & Powerlifting Academy has easily been one of the best decisions I’ve made for my fitness. Whether you’re into serious powerlifting or just trying to get stronger and stay in shape, the coaching here really adapts to you. It’s not a one-size-fits-all program. Everything is tailored based on your level, goals, and how your body responds.

What I like most is the balance they maintain. You can train seriously and push your limits, but at the same time it’s very welcoming even if you’re just starting out or focusing on general fitness. Vinutha Ma’am pays close attention to form and technique, which makes you feel confident and helps avoid injuries.

The environment is super positive: no unnecessary ego, just people trying to improve and supporting each other. Great place to build strength, confidence, and consistency.

featured_reviews.name: Swita
featured_reviews.review_text: Training under Vinutha ma’am has been an amazing journey. I started with just the bar, and now I’ve reached 120 kg because of her guidance, programming, and constant motivation. She knows exactly how to push you to your potential while making sure your technique and progress stay on track. Very grateful for her support and coaching.

featured_reviews.name: Biju Babu
featured_reviews.review_text:
Grooming a child athlete requires a balance of toughness and care, and Vinutha Raghunath Ma’am masters this perfectly. Over the last two years, she has mentored our 13-year-old daughter, Eva, not just in powerlifting, but in the lifestyle of a professional athlete.
Vinutha Ma'am's credentials as an IPF Certified Coach and active IPF Athlete allowed her to groom Eva with real-world experience. From District to State and now toward Nationals by 2027, the growth in Eva’s confidence and stature is remarkable. Follow her journey of growth on YouTube at Eva Biju and Instagram @Evaliftsss. For those looking to understand how a top-tier coach grooms talent, we highly recommend to get in touch Grippers Powerlifting Academy.

featured_reviews.name: Janhavi Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: Training at grippers was a great experience. I started training with the intention to get fit. I was not a fan of the gym, vinutha Ma’am changed that. I stated enjoying the process, week by week, kilo by kilo. Days with a PR and days with a failed attempt, all were learning opportunities and I owe this to her. Great place to get your form right and have fun doing it. And of course, a great coffee with it :)

featured_reviews.name: Prasad Rao
featured_reviews.review_text:
Beyond Just a Gym – It’s a Powerlifting Sanctuary
If you are looking for a place to just "work out," go to a commercial gym. But if you are looking to discover what you are truly capable of, this is the only place to be.
The Coach: Unconditional Support
The heart of this gym is the  coach. I have never met someone so genuinely invested in the success of every person who walks through the door. Her support is unconditional it doesn’t matter if you’re pulling 200kgs or just learning how to grip the barbell; she gives you 100% of her focus, expertise, and energy. She doesn’t just give you a program; she gives you the confidence to execute it.
The Philosophy: Strength Has No Age
What sets this environment apart is the culture. In this gym, age is truly just a number. You’ll see lifters of all generations grinding side-by-side. The atmosphere isn't about ego or aesthetics; it’s about the numbers on the bar and the grit in your heart.
Expert Technical Guidance: Precision coaching on the Big Three (Squat, Bench, Deadlift).
A Real Community: No judgment, just loud cheers and heavy plates.
Total Dedication:A coach who stays late and arrives early to ensure her students win.
At the end of the day, the only numbers that matter here are the ones you’re adding to the barbell. Whether you’re 20 or 60, if you want to get strong and be mentored by the best in the business, get in here.
Precision. Power. No Excuses.

featured_reviews.name: Bosco Philip
featured_reviews.review_text:
Subject:Poor Maintenance at MFC Gym

I am writing this review to bring to light a serious safety issue at MFC Gym that needs immediate attention. Today, during our workout session, a 25kg dumbbell unexpectedly fell apart while being used. Fortunately, no one was severely injured, but it was a near-miss incident that could have resulted in a serious head injury.

This is not the first time this has happened. The same dumbbell has broken multiple times in the past, yet the gym management has continuously ignored the issue. Instead of taking responsibility and ensuring the safety of its members by replacing faulty equipment, the gym owner responded with improper arguments, blaming us for using the damaged weights. His dismissive attitude and lack of concern for member safety are unacceptable.

The fact that this equipment failure has happened multiple times without proper action from the management is highly concerning. Rather than acknowledging the risk and taking steps to resolve it, we were advised to find alternative exercises instead of using the faulty weights. This is not a viable solution, as there is already a significant gap in the availability of weights between 25kg and 30kg, affecting our training routines. Additionally, whenever any equipment is broken or damaged, it takes several months for the gym to repair it, further highlighting their negligence.

Most importantly, the lack of an apology or any sense of guilt from the management speaks volumes about their negligence. Gym-goers should not have to put their lives at risk due to poor maintenance and irresponsibility from the gym owner.

I strongly urge potential members to reconsider before joining MFC Gym. Safety should be a top priority in any fitness facility, and unfortunately, MFC Gym has repeatedly failed in this regard. Until proper action is taken to ensure that all equipment is well-maintained and safe to use, I cannot recommend this gym to anyone who values their well-being.

I hope this review serves as a wake-up call for the gym management to take immediate corrective action before a serious injury occurs.

featured_reviews.name: Angel Sweety
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing and concerning culture at The Body Project Gym,
I was just about to join the gym but till then I got to know that a member was reportedly denied membership renewal because he was helping and guiding fellow gym members during workouts. The reason allegedly given was that such guidance was affecting the gym’s personal training business and reducing potential PT clients.

If this is true, it raises serious concerns for every member. And i am a person who is a beginner and obviously I need someone to help me at the start and i cant afford to keep a personal trainer for myself. If I am joining and i then am not allowed to have friends or ask anyone anything then it would be so dumb joining here....A gym should be a place where people support, motivate, and learn from each other. Denying renewal to someone simply because they share fitness knowledge with fellow members creates a toxic and insecure environment. When I enquired most of the people said not to join this GYM because of such behaviour, and i think people go to Gym to socialize themselves rather than isolating.

What is even more worrying is that if this can happen to one member today, it can happen to any member tomorrow. Many experienced gym-goers naturally help beginners with form, technique, or motivation without charging money or claiming to be trainers. Treating such interactions as a business threat reflects poorly on the management’s priorities.

Instead of focusing on member satisfaction, retention, and building a strong fitness community, it appears the emphasis is being placed solely on protecting personal training revenue.

A gym membership is a service paid for by members, not a privilege that can be arbitrarily denied. This incident leaves a very negative impression about the management’s attitude toward its own members.

featured_reviews.name: Devendran Kiranraj
featured_reviews.review_text:
You're not allowed to talk to other members inside. You're not allowed to work out alongside someone you know. If a fellow member asks for your help and you help them, the trainers will stare you down and report you to the owner like you committed a crime and the owner will 100% side with the trainer, no questions asked.
Speaking of trainers they completely ignore beginners doing exercises incorrectly. Want proper guidance? Pay extra for personal training. But don't worry, those same trainers will waltz into the middle of an ongoing group workout to accommodate their paying clients something regular members are strictly forbidden from doing.
This place has rules for customers and a completely different set of rules for staff. Avoid it.

featured_reviews.name: Harsh Gudhka
featured_reviews.review_text:
Training at The Body Project for the last 6 months has been a great experience. When I joined, my weight was 68 kg and I took personal training with Shrikant Sir. With his guidance and training, I have lost 10 kg, reduced fat, and gained muscle.

Shrikant Sir is extremely professional, knowledgeable, and motivating. He focuses a lot on correct form and consistency, which really helped me see results.

The gym ambience is excellent - modern machines, well-maintained equipment, clean space, and a very supportive environment. Overall, it’s a great place to train and stay motivated.

Highly recommend The Body Project to anyone serious about fitness!

featured_reviews.name: SAHIL GUPTA
featured_reviews.review_text:
The gym is excellent if you are experienced and already know about workouts. But if you are a beginner, taking admission in this gym is a red flag—don’t do it.

Unfortunately, I was a beginner with zero knowledge about gym and workout routines. After paying the full-year fees, I went to the gym on my first day feeling excited. I approached a trainer named Mangesh and asked what I should do since it was my first day, but I was completely ignored. I asked him multiple times to guide me or give me a workout plan, but he didn’t respond.

Even the gym executive, Pallavi, had said that I would be trained for one week by a trainer. However, despite multiple complaints, I was still ignored. Since I had already paid the fees, I had no choice but to learn everything about workouts and gym routines from YouTube.

So, listen carefully: if you pay the trainer for personal training (PT), only then will they pay attention to you. Otherwise, you don’t exist there.

“By explaining my concern to Raj Sir (the owner), he politely listened to my problem and tried to resolve it. This was a great gesture from his side. The gym equipment is excellent, and the washrooms are hygienic. Raj Sir and his team have taken this issue seriously, and they are now the best gym in Sion.”

featured_reviews.name: Himanshu Ratti
featured_reviews.review_text:
After undergoing multiple surgeries last year, my physiotherapist advised me to join a gym for rehab and strength building. I signed up at The Body Project Gym, and it’s been great journey till now.

I’ve been training with Shrikant sir, and the progress I’ve seen has been incredible. He understands my limitations, tailors every workout to my recovery needs, and pushes me just the right amount. His knowledge, patience, and focus on proper form have helped me regain strength and confidence.

The gym has a great environment, supportive staff, and all the equipment needed for safe and effective training.

featured_reviews.name: Sachin Kewat
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've been a member of [ Body Project Gym ] for about six months, and overall, I'm very happy with my experience. The facility is consistently clean and well-maintained, and the staff are always friendly and helpful when you have a question.
The cardio equipment is plentiful and rarely wait-listed, which is a huge plus. The instructors are high-energy and offer great modifications for all levels. I especially recommend the [ Srikanth sir, pritesh sir ] the nature of the person is quite good, whenever I need tips or support for while lifting he always there. And the receptionist named Pallavi ma'am is too friendly if you find any difficulty she will be there for you without any concern.

Overall: If you're looking for a well maintained, clean and welcoming environment to get your workout in, [Body Project Gym] is an excellent choice!
